questions.question_text: Which of the following is a commonphysicalindicator of stress in teens?

options.text: Feeling irritable or snapping at others
Worrying constantly about the future
Experiencing frequent headaches or stomachaches
Avoiding social situations or responsibilities

questions.question_text: When should a teen consider seeking support for stress?

options.text: When they feel stressed for a single day
When stress feels unmanageable or lasts for weeks
Only when they have a big test coming up
When they feel a little tired after school

correct_answer.text: When stress feels unmanageable or lasts for weeks

questions.question_text: What is one benefit of practicing mindfulness as a stress-relief technique?

options.text: It helps build physical strength and endurance
It quiets a racing mind and reduces anxiety
It organizes your schoolwork and deadlines
It improves your grades automatically

correct_answer.text: It quiets a racing mind and reduces anxiety

questions.question_text: Which strategy can help balance school and personal life for a teen?

options.text: Studying all night to finish assignments
Setting a cutoff time for schoolwork to allow personal time
Ignoring friends to focus only on grades
Taking on extra activities even when overwhelmed

correct_answer.text: Setting a cutoff time for schoolwork to allow personal time

questions.question_text: Why is downtime considered an important part of self-care for teens?

options.text: It allows you to avoid all responsibilities permanently
It helps recharge your energy and prevent burnout
It guarantees better grades without studying
It means spending all day on social media

correct_answer.text: It helps recharge your energy and prevent burnout

questions.question_text: Which of the following is a healthy habit that supports emotional well-being?

options.text: Staying up late every night to finish homework
Skipping meals to save time for activities
Aiming for 8-10 hours of sleep per night
Spending all free time on social media

correct_answer.text: Aiming for 8-10 hours of sleep per night
